chunks: From him, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a people whose Imam led them in salat while he was without taharah. Is their salat valid, or must they repeat it? He said: There is no repetition upon them; their salat is complete. The repetition is upon him, and it is not incumbent upon him to inform them. This is waived from him.

key_terms.إِعَادَةَ: repetition of the prayer due to invalidity or defect
key_terms.تَمَّتْ: was completed and counted as valid
key_terms.صَلَاتُهُمْ: the congregational prayer performed by the followers
key_terms.طَهُورٍ: ritual purity required for the validity of salat
key_terms.يُعْلِمَهُمْ: to inform the followers of the matter

ai.seo_question: If an Imam leads salat without taharah, do the followers have to repeat their prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning congregational salat when the Imam led the people without taharah. It states that the followers' salat remains valid and complete, while the Imam himself must repeat his own salat, and he is not required to inform them.
